articles.summary: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., May 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics, Inc., or BBOT (NASDAQ: BBOT), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on RAS-pathway malignancies, today announced it awarded inducement grants on May 10, 2026 under BBOT’s 2025 Inducement Plan
articles.title: BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
